notes.title: Union of Gnomes is out in full release!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades!

The hour has come! The gnomes are regrouping and returning — stronger, meaner, and funnier than ever before!

[previewyoutube=yHzrdwKKvso;full][/previewyoutube]

Welcome the full release of Union of Gnomes, packed with content, new features, and unexpected surprises.

What’s new:
[list]
[*] New mission: “Snow White’s Villa”—a dark fairy tale with a twisted ending
[*] 7 new monsters
[*] 3 new bosses: The Little Mermaid (yes, she’s really mean), Snow White, and… someone else we won’t spoil just yet
[*] 4 fresh new quests
[*] 10 new maps
[*] 2 secret mechanics leading to a hidden boss
[*] 1 hidden comic-style cutscene at the end
[*] Combat tutorial right at the start — no boring text dumps!
[*] New mission: “Fatport” — harbor drama, and gnomes in peril
[*] Final comic cutscene — the grand story conclusion
[/list]
In honor of the release — [b]35% OFF![/b] A great deal. Grab it now!

We also decided to create a bundle with another awesome gnome game, so you can get a double dose of gnomish madness and mayhem in one go! Don’t miss this great chance to grab two games at once with a sweet 10% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53222/Youve_been_Gnomed 
 
Gnomes is a turn-based tower defense with deep roguelike progression. Build, farm and defend your village as you push deeper into goblin-infested territory. Unlock powerful upgrades and craft your environment to survive the endless goblin horde.

Remember: by buying the game, you’re supporting a noble cause — the fight for freedom and independence — values shared by all humankind… and gnomekind.

Please leave a review on Steam — your support keeps us motivated and helps us grow the game!

Freedom to the Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: The Updated Hardcore Mode is Now Available in the Beta Branch!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades!

We’ve gathered feedback from everyone who participated in the playtest of the hardcore mode and made several significant changes to enhance your experience.

What’s New:
[olist]
[*] New Feature: "Secrets of the Looking Glass": Discover the mysterious story that led to the gnomes being enslaved by Snow White. To unlock this tale, you’ll need to complete challenging trials, but the rewards will be worth it! Not only will you learn this secret history, but you’ll also receive powerful gear for your van and rare gnomes. 14 secrets and 14 trials await you!
[*] New Steam Achievements in the Looking Glass: We’ve added 13 additional achievements specifically for the Looking Glass mode (making a total of 27 with the Secrets!).
[*] Updated Sounds and Effects in the Looking Glass mode: We’ve enhanced the atmosphere and mystery with new sounds and have voiced many player actions within the Looking Glass.
[*] New Reward System in the Looking Glass: Rewards now scale with the difficulty of battles and increase at each stage. You’ll earn more Golden Teeth for defeating bosses and can equip your van with the latest in fairy engineering faster! Defeating bosses will also yield Blings, which will help create powerful squads.
[*] Hero control on the Looking Glass Map with keyboard: You can now control your hero using WASD and confirm actions with the Spacebar. Additionally, the Hunger Counter is now displayed on the target’s cross.
[*] Significant work on graphics and interfaces in the Looking Glass mode: We’ve refined many elements and details to enhance the atmosphere and immersion in this adventure. The Compass and Hunger widgets have been improved, and many screens in the Looking Glass received additional effects and animations.
[*] Extensive balancing work based on player feedback:
[list]
[*] Looking Glass mode difficulty balance: difficulty now increases more smoothly.
[*] Hunger balance: gnome buffs have been strengthened, and the Hunger screen has been improved.
[*] Curses Balance: "Unfair" сurses  have been weakened.
[*] Boss balance in the Looking Glass: excessively powerful bosses have been adjusted.
[/list]
[*] Bug fixes and text corrections: numerous bugs and text errors have been resolved.
[/olist]
We hope that playing will now be more comfortable, enjoyable, and… challenging. After all, that’s why we’re here! 

Experience the updates for yourself!

You can access the build by following a simple instruction: 

1. Click on Properties:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721800/0f58e67e1556b6ecc54720f63935242ddbf57eac.png[/img]
2. Then Betas: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721800/64480d7a7a1f7e774b14564940ee21a54b0c343a.png[/img]
3. Choose the available version.

We look forward to your feedback, comments, suggestions, and ideas here or on [url=https://discord.gg/m6rnQMmtM2]Discord[/url].



Freedom to the Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Open Beta Test of the New Hardcore Roguelike Mode! Join Us!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2097030/announcements/detail/503941572582182316?snr=2___]Previously[/url], we shared that we’ve been working on an especially challenging (truly fierce!) roguelike mode for the game. We’re excited to announce that it’s almost ready, and we invite you to participate in the open beta testing!

Let’s briefly explain how this new mode differs from the main game. In this mode, a new world will unfold before you every time you play. In this mode, a new world will unfold before players each time. Every run will be made more challenging by Snow White’s tricks, and you’ll gather your team of gnomes under new rules. It allows you to create various decks to suit your play style. Each run in this mode consists of three consecutive stages—easy, medium, and hard. We hope you’ll enjoy it!

And there are new achievements to unlock!

You can access the build by following a simple instruction: 

1. Click on Properties:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721800/0f58e67e1556b6ecc54720f63935242ddbf57eac.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721800/64480d7a7a1f7e774b14564940ee21a54b0c343a.png[/img]

We look forward to your feedback, comments, suggestions, and ideas here or on [url=https://discord.gg/m6rnQMmtM2]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Get ready to storm the University — the winter update is out!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades!

The gnome squad is bravely marching forward to defeat Snow White and claim their long-awaited freedom. Today marks the beginning of a new battle: the attack on the University.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721800/3be4a5ef2f786b182641dfbbbc3121913bb406f0.png[/img]

It all began here. The University is where Snow White founded her secret society, studying dark magic, performing forbidden rituals, and crafting the song that enslaved the gnomes. To defeat her, you must uncover the truth by finding Snow White's secret diary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721800/eb7633a398180517a2e50a11a9433c14ab355529.png[/img]

But it won’t be easy! Though Snow White has long since graduated, her dark influence lingers. Living skeletons, enchanted books, monstrous cabbages, young students, and followers of dark magic—all will stand in the way of the brave gnomes.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/LdXQZMN/boss-bomb.gif[/img]

You’ll need all your courage and wit to defeat these foes and make your way to the library, where the ultimate challenge awaits: the Yule Cat. This cunning and devious boss will push your skills to the limit, but the gnomes are no strangers to fighting with everything they’ve got.

[b]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]A new location: [/b]University.
[*] [b]Six new monsters[/b] to challenge your skills.
[*] [b]Four quests[/b] full of intrigue and danger.
[*] [b]A new boss:[/b] the Yule Cat.
[/list]
Update your game, dive into thrilling card battles, and don’t forget to share your feedback with us by leaving a review!

Freedom to the Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: A new hero, cards, and a mysterious quest!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades!

It's been less than a month since we released our last update… and we're excited to announce that we already have a brand-new update ready for you!

[h3][b]A new hero![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721800/ddb6d7cc4c1f63f37b7b9955e431b51fbc3f271c.png[/img]

An alpaca-riding battle commander, who comes with 12 class cards, 9 talents, and 2 perks.

[h3][b]Blings[/b][/h3]

It's time for GREAT RELICS! POWERFUL ARTIFACTS! What? No… wrong text? It's not gnome style? Hmm…

Meet Blings: they're not legendary relics or heroic artifacts but useful trinkets that gnomes can equip and use in battle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721800/c697d965c6f6d4638c3ba68ca2280712ae6b34e1.png[/img]

Just an example: put a BUSH in your hand – yes, a bush is a beautiful bling worn by gnomes. If any gnome hides in that, he can heal you. Weird? No, that's okay!

How about Cutters: any captured gnome or cursed gnome that falls into this slot will be released, and you'll get a fresh fighter in the middle of battle. Great!

[h3][b]Mystery? No, no myste–Just another quest![/b][/h3]

If you think Snow White just went crazy and enslaved the gnomes, then everything is going according to plan. But if you're the nerd who picks up on all the weirdness and believes in conspiracy theories... then you might hear The Voice.

The Voice that calls you to a mysterious cave that never existed in the gnome woods… and that Voice promises to reveal the truth behind the Mystery that you've longed to know.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/BNHYSVn/image.gif [/img]

In this update, we will slightly lift the veil of mystery that already runs through the entire game. Inquisitive players could see parts of it in the demo and in the prologue, and someone was already able to discover parts of it in the Early Access release.

Let the candles light your way in this dark story because – with the unlocking of the next part of the puzzle in this update – you will obtain a new hero. This is the same proud gnome who was very close to the solution!

In addition, we have replaced the ability to discard cards after combat with the option to reroll dropped cards. We hope you enjoy it.

In honor of the update, we're giving a nice discount on the game that will be valid for two weeks! Be sure to buy it for yourself or as a gift!

Update the game, lead your squad of desperate fighters forward, and achieve freedom for all the gnomes. Don't forget to leave reviews of the game on Steam, share your thoughts and ideas about the game in the Discussions, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZhjKSKRFrh]Discord[/url].

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Welcome to the Bloodwood — a new mission of increased difficulty!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades!

Union of Gnomes will be a part of the Ghouls 4 Games festival, which starts on October 24! In honor of this spooky event, we are preparing a new game update: the Bloodwood.

Your squad of gnomes is forced to travel the lands of the Bloody Baroness in this difficult mission that will feel like HELLFIRE.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/3vXdQYC/2024-10-24-13-19-06.gif[/img]

The Baroness and her lackeys started hunting gnomes in the Apple Grove, otherwise known as the "Bloodwood," believing that bathing in their blood would keep her eternally beautiful.

Test your tactical skills against this challenging villain. Defeating her will grant you a new LEGENDARY card that… that you'll just have to find out for yourself.

The update will include:
[list]
[*] The new "Bloodwood" mission,
[*] New boss: the "Bloody Baroness",
[*] A new special buff for the mission "Bloody Hunt" for the secret build.
[*] And 2 new cards: "Comrade!" and "Gnolem."
[/list]
Update the game and fight villains for equality, freedom, and your gnome brothers. Don't forget to leave reviews of the game on Steam, and share your thoughts and ideas about the game in the Discussions and our [url=https://discord.gg/ZhjKSKRFrh]Discord[/url].

Free the Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Big story update: new missions, cards, and mechanics!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades!

Today, we push forward and continue the fight against Snow White and her tyrannical rule of the kingdom! The new update sees our gnomish squad of rebels encounter phantasmagorical Dream Factory, the noisy Southern Market, and more hellish missions that contain the strongest packs of monsters with unfair difficulty levels.  

This is what's new in the update: : 
[list]
[*] 2 story missions;
[*] 1 quest mission;
[*] 1 super-difficult mission;
[*] 9 gnome cards for the collection and 12 new cards in missions;
[*] 8 new monsters and 4 new bosses;
[*] And the Italian language option has been added! 
[/list]

Here are the full details!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/hghCjKs/image.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Mission "The Dream Factory"[/b][/h3]
When you arrive at the Dream Factory, you will encounter new enemies and unfair rules that give creatures an advantage, making fights even harder than before.  The gnomes will face off against wrestlers, boxers, and… cheerleaders. If you don't stop them at the root, these fearsome foes can deliver critical blows with their special skills.

For example, the "Ram" boxer moves forward after an attack and uses critical blows while in the first position. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/fSxw58W/image.gif[/img]

In the finale, you will battle the Great Oz. Frantically moving around the circus ring and turning your gnomes into all manner of DIFFERENT things, he will crush you. 

[h3][b]South Market Mission[/b][/h3]
This is where gnome goods and wares are sold. Everything is bought and sold here, and some cards can be played for COINS, so you can't do without gold. Additional coins can be taken from monsters, but they will not miss the opportunity to get into your pocket. For example, an enemy can obtain and use a special buff named "Thief", which removes 5 gold from your wallet with each attack against you.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZH93zXR/image.gif[/img]

The South Market has brand new enemies – sellers and shopaholics – all of whom will buy tons of "gnomes" goods and refuse to relinquish their passion for consumerism. Beating them will reward you with VERY powerful cards, VERY sinister curse cards, and COOL goods.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/GtRpmzC/2.gif[/img]

This shopping trip will end in a duel with Couturier Knockoff, who will cut you up with a pair of scissors and leave you to be eaten by his tamed pigeons.

[h3][b]New cards[/b][/h3]
The theme of this act's new cards is combos. We wanted to create more cards that can be combined to obtain powerful effects. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/RPhqw2k/image.gif[/img]

For example, the Rocket card cannot be played, however, upon discarding it, it will inflict a total damage of 10 to all opponents. This is a great card to combo with gnomes discarding other cards. 

We also created cards called "Holy Gnomes." Use them to create a build that will heal you and destroy your enemies with these same healing dwarves. Among these cards, the "Holy Gnomes" grant you a buff that doubles your healing ability, and the "Sinner" gnome grants you a buff that allows you to deal damage with healing. 

Play Union of Gnomes and keep fighting for equality and freedom. Don't forget to write reviews of the game on Steam and talk about it in the Discussions. 

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Optimization for wide screens and cards and enemies rebalance!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades!

We're in the middle of developing the third act but decided to take a pause to improve and fix many of the things you've been writing to us about. So, here's a list of improvements:

[list]
[*] Big sausage rebalance. Heroes at the start of missions are given 150 sausages. Reduced sausage consumption by gnomes. BBQ gnome now brings a lot more sausages on crits. From now on, hunger makes much less pain.
[*] Big card rebalance.
[*] Enemies rebalance - now, they are a bit stronger in their basic actions (tanks, healers, dd). 
[*] Changed Fighter hero talents based on the Drunk buff - now they are really useful talents and you can safely build a Drunk-build.
[*] Corrected a large number of typos and mistakes in English.
[*] Improved game screen layout for the following resolutions: 2560x1080, 2650x1440, 3840x2160. Changed screen mode settings - they should not cause problems (if they do, we'll fix them again - we will be checking discussions to stay in touch with you on this issue).
[/list]
Update the game, play, and have fun! We continue to work on the next update and will soon delight you with new levels, cards, and quests. 

Freedom to Gnomes!

Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Union of Gnomes is out in Early Access!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades!

A warband of gnomes is ready to stand up against Snow White's tyranny and storm the Gnomontanomo to end gnome trafficking and stop their brothers' oppression! We are waiting only for you, the bold leader of the gnome movement for freedom, equality, and the right to be a gnome in any situation. 

[previewyoutube=hUkMF_3Lw0s;full][/previewyoutube]

Discover the dark side of characters from your favorite fairy tales, fight them in tense battles, and make the most of your squad's abilities and talents. Combine different cards and create unusual and spectacular combos to defeat the enemy with minimal losses.

Below, you can check out our plans for the game's Early Access phase.

[h2][b]Early Access: [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] 2 acts of six;
[*] 5 story missions;
[*] 3 story adventures with bosses;
[*] 29 quests;
[*] 28 common enemies;
[*] 8 bosses;
[*] 2 heroes with unique features and talents;
[*] 18 hero talents;
[*] 97 gnome cards;
[*] And 1 very special Neverending Nightmare Mode.
[/list]
[h2][b]ACT III Let’s bust the propaganda nest![/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] New Bosses: The Wizard of Oz, Couturier Knonoff
[*] New Enemies and Quests
[*] MORE GNOMES!
[/list]
[h2][b]ACT IV The Road To University.[/b][/h2]
Seekings of a Snow White’s Secret
[list]
[*] New enemies and strange creatures: Sirin, Alkonost, and Black Goat.
[*] And, sure thing, new recruits to the gnomes' posse!
[/list]
[h2][b]New hero - Commander![/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Quality of Life improvements 
[*] New heroes’ talents!
[*] Definitely new gnomes!
[/list]
[h2][b]The Circles of Madness[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Update for a Neverending Nightmare Mode!
[*] Does the Candle still burn?
[/list]
[h2][b]Act V The Kings' Cesspool - Smelly Fatport[/b][/h2]
The smugglers’, pirates' and the mermaid's hideout
[list]
[*] Will you be the same after facing the mermaid?? 
[*] Also introducing Ali Baba, who surely won't show his coins!
[/list]
[h2][b]Full Release, Pu-pu-ru-pu! Totally Finalish Finale! MEET THE SNOW WHITE![/b][/h2]
Agenda:
[list]
[*] Сorrupt liar judge, Naked King!
[*] Сastle party, networking amusements, monsters, and quests! 
[*] And, as tradition demands, new gnomes!
[/list]
At all stages of development, we are eager for your feedback, bug reports, ideas for game development, and anything else you wish to share with the Union of Gnomes team.

Meanwhile... let's go! Let's overthrow Snow White and free the gnomes from years of slavery! 

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Play the updated Union of Gnomes demo!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades! 

Union of Gnomes is participating in Steam Next Fest. You can support us by playing our gnome-fighting, sausage-munching, and updated demo!
[list]
[*] We added a mini-tutorial to the main menu. It briefly explains the purpose of each house in the gnome camp.
[*] We also added a mini-tutorial, to help players understand the basic mechanics of combat. 
[*] It includes fixed flaws in Chinese localization.

notes.title: The new Union of Gnomes demo or... Neverending Nightmare!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades! 

We are releasing a brand new demo for Union of Gnomes, called "Neverending Nightmare!" It includes a never-before-seen mode – forget about the previous demos, you absolutely must play this new experience.

[previewyoutube=WRdKEWBXuN0;full][/previewyoutube]

This is what's in the new demo: 
[list]
[*] The brand new Neverending Nightmare mode itself. 
[*] 2 heroes, each with 8 unique characteristics and 9 different talents;
[*] 92 cards with cool effects, which will allow you to create spectacular combos;
[*] 19 enemies and 5 bosses;
[*] The new “Teams'' feature. The Gnome's wagon is no longer just a transport vehicle, but a full-fledged combat unit with powerful bonuses: zero the cost of cards, restore health, and do massive damage to enemies.
[/list]
Thanks to an outpouring of player feedback, we've rebalanced the sausage system and increased the amount of food produced in shelters. Additionally, in the new Neverending Nightmare mode, dwarves do not eat sausages –- you will only need them to form a Team.

We hope you will enjoy the new demo. After all, that's what it's all about: drive, fun, and harsh gnome's humor. 

Download the Neverending Nightmare demo, add the full Union of Gnomes game to your Wishlist, share your impressions, and have fun! 

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: HEROES NEVER DIE!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades! 

Thanks to all of the feedback we received on the Union of Gnomes last demo, we're hard at work improving the existing aspects of the game while adding brand new ones.

One of these changes is that HEROES NEVER DIE!

That's right, we've given the hero system a lot of thought and realized that forcing the player to create a new hero when it dies will devalue the system. In fact, players love to develop one character and end up being more attached to them. Now, your hero will be constant (even if they fall in battle) and keep their progression.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/72cCp7G/pirozhok.gif[/img]

In our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2097030/view/3749869144024818048]previous update[/url], we showed the development of two bosses: Red Riding Hood and her grandmother. The crazy hag keeps insisting that you have some Pirozhok (a delicious Slavic dish) and will add it to your deck, but you can use the card against her!

Speaking of cards, we've added some cool new ones.

For example, [b]Heartbreaker[/b] will punish an enemy that tries to heal themselves. Instead of receiving health points, they will take the same amount of damage instead. This works great on nuns, who focus on healing their entire squad. You can also kill an opponent with this debuff by using a healing card as it'll convert the points into damage.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/2vj4mQv/Deathproof.gif[/img]

[b]Deathproof[/b] gives the player a buff called "Unkillable", which will stop the hero's health point from dropping below 1. Even poison can't kill them.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/zxjJktF/Bomby.gif[/img]

The [b]Bomby[/b] card allows the player to cast a "Bomb!" debuff on the opponent. With each turn, the debuff ticks down and decreases. And when it reaches zero, the bomb will explode and deal a lot of damage.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/ssq5TDr/Thief.gif[/img]

[b]Thief[/b] is applied to the enemy, and steals (obviously) all of the perks the unit should have received. Healing, armor, and other buffs are given to the player's hero instead of the enemy.

In addition, we have also:
[list]
[*] Removed unnecessary resources and simplified resource management. 
[*] Added tooltips for everything. 
[*] Improved many existing VFX and added new ones. 
[*] Made the interface clearer and more user-friendly.
[*] And much more. 
[/list]
That's it for this update. Please leave a comment telling us what you liked about our latest update, and suggest what we should talk about next. Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/jejBb3JvNw]Discord[/url] server.

Freedom to Gnomes!
The Union of Gnomes Party
